title: Database Cleanup "corrupts" database, showing "red line in" overview.
symptom: After running Database Cleanup from Maintenance, AAPS shows a red line in the overview and in the History browser, including in the past, as if the loop was disabled. The problem can be fixed through database reset + full NS sync.
fix: The problem can be fixed through database reset + full NS sync. However, the issue reporter later noted that the problem solved itself and could not reproduce it anymore.
evidence_quote: Problem can be fixed through database reset + full NS sync
